name: Sami Curtain Advertisement
author: Samee Ullah Feroz

sections.description:
Sami Curtain Advertisement displays a gently animated curtain in a corner of your website. The subtle movement draws attention without opening the advertisement automatically.

When a visitor clicks the curtain, the advertisement slides in from the opposite side of the screen. The background dims, the curtain animation pauses, and the ad appears centered in an A4-style frame. Closing the ad reverses the animation and resumes the curtain’s movement.

Features:

  • Continuously animated curtain that pauses automatically while the ad is open.
  • Left or right corner placement, with the ad always entering from the opposite side.
  • Three curtain/carpet artwork themes, each with a visual thumbnail in the admin.
  • Website page-fold design concept with adjustable pixel dimensions (≈300 × 300 px by default).
  • Customizable accent, popup, and button colors.
  • Optional transparent PNG logo, with independent visibility settings for the curtain and the ad.
  • Drag-and-position controls for the logo, with separate placement on the curtain and the ad.
  • Draw and resize an invisible clickable area directly over an existing banner button.
  • Optional visible custom button for banners that don’t already include one.
  • Only the defined hotspot or button is clickable — the rest of the banner stays unlinked.
  • Local tracking of impressions, opens, unique session opens, closes, and link clicks.
  • Optional “Powered by Ping Booster” credit, off by default.
  • No external analytics service, account, or license required — all data stays on your site.
    All JavaScript and CSS in this plugin is hand-written, human-readable source with no build step, bundler, or minifier involved — what ships in the plugin package is the full and only source code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Sami Curtain Advertisement.
  3. Open Sami Curtain Advertisement > Ad Editor.
  4. Upload a banner and optional transparent PNG company logo.
  5. Select the curtain design, colors, jewellery and side.
  6. Choose whether to select an existing banner area or add a new button.
  7. Enter the URL, position and resize the selected area in the preview.
  8. Enable Sami Curtain Advertisement and save.
sections.faq:
Is the complete banner clickable?

No. Only the selected hotspot or optional generated button contains the destination link.

Where is analytics data stored?

Aggregate counts are stored locally in WordPress and are not sent to Ping Booster.

Does the curtain keep moving?

Yes. It moves until opened, pauses while open, and resumes after closing.

Is Ping Booster front-end branding required?

No. The optional credit is disabled by default.

Must I add a separate company logo?

No. The logo is optional. You can hide it from the curtain, advertisement, or both when the uploaded banner already contains branding.
sections.changelog:
1.0.13

  • Renamed the plugin from Funky Ad to Sami Curtain Advertisement (slug changed to sami-curtain-advertisement) for directory approval.
  • Removed the unnecessary load_plugin_textdomain() call; WordPress.org auto-loads translations since 4.6.
  • Removed WordPress.org directory-only assets (icon, logo) from the plugin package.
  • Reformatted admin JavaScript for readability; no functional changes.
  • Shortened the readme short description to meet the 150-character limit.

1.0.11

  • Added a detailed Sami Curtain Advertisement overview and usage guide beneath Analytics.
  • Added explanations for every analytics metric.
  • Added a voluntary Support Ping Booster switch for the optional powered-by credit.
  • Added a direct Ad Editor shortcut from the Analytics information section.

1.0.10

  • Removed the hanging jewellery and jhoomer from the frontend.
  • Removed the jewellery selector from the advertisement editor.
  • Retained all animated curtain and carpet designs.

1.0.9

  • Added transparent 24-frame animated cloth GIFs for every cover design.
  • Replaced rigid whole-cover bouncing with true fabric-edge deformation.
  • Added automatic animated-to-static swapping while the advertisement is open.
  • Restarts cloth motion after the reverse carpet return completes.

1.0.8

  • Replaced the 3D card flip with a flying-carpet unroll and roll-back animation.
  • Added a visibly stronger whole-cover attention movement.
  • Made the closed cover movement independent of JavaScript transforms.
  • Removed the 180-degree curtain flip during opening and closing.

1.0.7

  • Added up to 20 independent links on one advertisement banner.
  • Added per-area URL, label, invisible/visible mode, button text and new-tab behavior.
  • Added visual selection, dragging, resizing and removal for every linked area.
  • Blocked overlapping link areas in both the editor and server-side sanitization.
  • Added click tracking to every configured link area.

1.0.6

  • Made hotspot placement generic for every banner and image aspect ratio.
  • Normalized all hotspot coordinates against the exact rendered image.
  • Expanded hotspot sizing to 1-100 percent for small or large linked areas.

1.0.5

  • Corrected link-area and logo coordinates to use the exact banner image stage.
  • Added continuous JavaScript movement for the complete closed cover.
  • The fold, genie eyes, company logo and jewellery now move together.
  • Movement stops during opening and resumes after the reverse close animation.

1.0.4

  • Fixed frontend initialization so clicking the folded corner reliably opens the advertisement.
  • Doubled the default trigger footprint to approximately 300 x 300 pixels.
  • Added the original Website Page Fold concept with a clear backside logo area.
  • Added JavaScript-controlled 3D launch and reverse-return states.
  • Changed banner entry to a perspective flip that comes forward from the page corner.

1.0.3

  • Replaced the oversized CSS triangle with transparent curtain artwork.
  • Added Royal Satin, Theatre Velvet and Persian Carpet visual samples.
  • Changed the default closed-curtain footprint to approximately 150 x 150 pixels.
  • Strengthened the gentle-breeze motion and kept it paused while the ad is open.
  • Added legacy setting migration and a no-JavaScript content fallback.

1.0.2

  • Made the uploaded company logo optional.
  • Added separate visibility controls for the curtain and advertisement logos.
  • Added draggable advertisement-logo positioning and separate X/Y controls.
  • Added separate curtain-logo positioning controls.

1.0.1

  • Replaced the forced visible CTA with an invisible resizable link-area mode.
  • Added an optional custom-button mode for banners without existing button artwork.
  • Added drag-and-resize controls based on the approved editor behavior.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
